_comment: What each Maven dependency of cefrium-sdk is for, for cefrium.com/components/. components-page.py fails if the POM has a dependency missing here, or this lists one the POM no longer has. 'calls' = classes in the SDK AAR that reference the library (measured with components-page.py --refs).
androidx.appcompat:appcompat: Chromium's Android dialogs, pickers and menus.
androidx.mediarouter:mediarouter: The media router behind Cast device pickers.
androidx.core:core: Compatibility helpers used throughout the engine's Java code.
androidx.browser:browser: Custom Tabs and Trusted Web Activity helpers in Chromium's intent handling.
androidx.datastore:datastore-preferences: Firebase Installations' key store, for Web Push over FCM. No Chromium or Cefrium class uses it.
androidx.window.extensions.core:core: Window layout on foldables and large screens.
com.airbnb.android:lottie: Animations in Chrome screens the engine does not show.
com.google.android.material:material: Material widgets in Chromium's Android UI.
com.google.guava:guava: Utility library used by Chromium's Java code.
com.google.protobuf:protobuf-javalite: Protocol buffers, the format Chromium's Java code exchanges data in.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-bas: Play services core: the availability check every Play services library starts with.
Play services core: connection and error handling.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-tas: Play services core: the asynchronous task API.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-aut: WebOTP: reads the one-time code from an SMS (SMS Retriever, User Consent).
Part of Chromium's Play services set. No Chromium or Cefrium class calls it.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-cas: Cast: the Presentation API and Remote Playback to Cast devices.
Cast: session handling for the Presentation API.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-ide: Digital Credentials API (credentials held by a wallet app).
com.google.android.gms:play-services-loc: Geolocation API: fused location (GPS, Wi-Fi and cell).
com.google.android.gms:play-services-vis: Shape Detection API: the part shared by the detectors.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-cle: Required by play-services-vision-common. No Chromium or Cefrium class calls it.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-phe: Required by play-services-clearcut and -vision-common. No Chromium or Cefrium class calls it.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-fla: Required by play-services-cast and -vision-common. No Chromium or Cefrium class calls it.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-sta: Required by the push libraries. No Chromium or Cefrium class calls it.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-clo: Web Push over FCM: message delivery.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-gcm: Web Push over FCM: the subscription (InstanceID) API.
com.google.android.gms:play-services-iid: Web Push over FCM: InstanceID tokens.
com.google.firebase:firebase-messaging: Web Push over FCM, and CefriumPushService for apps without their own Firebase service.
com.google.android.datatransport:transpo: Required by firebase-messaging, Cast and ML Kit. No Chromium or Cefrium class calls it.
Required by firebase-messaging, Cast and ML Kit. No Chromium or Cefrium class calls it.
Required by firebase-messaging, Cast and ML Kit. No Chromium or Cefrium class calls it.
com.google.mlkit:common: On-device AI (Prompt API through Gemini Nano). The API is off in Cefrium builds.
com.google.mlkit:genai-common: On-device AI (Prompt API through Gemini Nano). The API is off in Cefrium builds.
com.google.mlkit:genai-prompt: On-device AI (Prompt API through Gemini Nano). The API is off in Cefrium builds.
com.google.mlkit:genai-schema: On-device AI (Prompt API through Gemini Nano). The API is off in Cefrium builds.
com.google.android.play:feature-delivery: Chromium's module installer for Play Feature Delivery; the engine installs no modules. An app that delivers the engine as a feature module declares it itself.
com.google.android.play:review: Chrome's in-app review prompt. No Chromium or Cefrium class calls it.
